name: Gmail MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to interact with Gmail through OAuth2 authentication, allowing users to list, search, read emails, and create drafts with a safety-first design that prevents accidental sends by default.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI assistants to interact with Gmail through OAuth2 authentication, allowing users to list, search, read emails, and create drafts with a safety-first design that prevents accidental sends by default.

GMAIL_CLIENT_ID.description: Your Gmail OAuth2 client ID from Google Cloud Console

GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your Gmail OAuth2 client secret from Google Cloud Console

GMAIL_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Your Gmail OAuth2 refresh token (generate using npm run setup)

OAUTH_REDIRECT_PORT.description: OAuth setup port (must match the redirect URI configured in Google Cloud Console)

GMAIL_ALLOW_DIRECT_SEND.description: Enable direct email sending (disabled by default for safety - creates drafts instead)
